bio: The Four Seasons Gresham Palace hotel is a beautiful art nouveau building which was constructed in 1906 for the Gresham Life Assurance Company. Set in the heart of Budapest, directly opposite the Széchenyi Chain Bridge, its restaurant makes the perfect place to dine when visiting the city. The relaxed, cosy atmosphere is matched perfectly by a menu of familiar French brasserie classics, with a few Hungarian dishes thrown in. The steak tartare is made at the table, the roast chicken for two is carved in front of you and the rum baba is a hit....
